cohort: 420 pregnant women living with HIV (WLWH) at a tertiary care institution
finding: The study found a low rate of vertical HIV transmission (0.2%) in a cohort of WLWH receiving ART, highlighting the effectiveness of interdisciplinary prenatal care and high experience of healthcare providers.
mod_finding: The most frequent indication for an elective caesarean section in the cohort was a previous caesarean section (70.2%).
